title: Can you beat 214 milliseconds?

lines.text: Can you beat two hundred and fourteen milliseconds?
Two hundred and fourteen. A new record.
Now I pull the plug. Everything goes dark.
Plug it back in... and the record is still there.
The ESP32 times your press with its own stopwatch,
and keeps the best time in a little drawer that survives without power.
A tiny screen, a buzzer, one button. That's the whole game.
Want to build things like this? Follow the channel, and post your best time in the comments.
